verdict.rationale: The two diffs are byte-for-byte identical. Both replace the quadratic findIndex scan with a Map from normalized email to index, built once. New entries are added to the map, so first-wins and arrival-order behavior are preserved. Both reports are accurate and say the speedup was not benchmarked. A adds the useful note that mergeContact keeps the existing email, so map keys stay valid. B gives the exact test count (8 of 8, which matches the repo) and explains why no test was added. The differences are minor and offset each other.
a_issues: No benchmark or regression test showing the speedup at 30k/50k scale.
The report says the tests pass but doesn't say which commands were run.
b_issues: No benchmark or regression test showing the speedup at 30k/50k scale.
